column1: # Native gates (SPU pass 122; KZ2's native_gates.tsv design): lifted SPU functions that hand over to a native host
# implementation (port/spu/kz3_native_post.c, kz3_native_dof.c) when their env flag is set. tools/spu/lift_spu.py
# native_gates() inserts the gate as the first statement of each listed function; the slot indexes
# g_kz3_native_gate[] (defined once in port/spu/kz3_native_jobs.c). A gate returns 1 when it ran the whole subroutine
# (the lifted body is skipped, the function returns to its link as `bi $r0`), 0 to run the lifted body. Rows are keyed
# by lifted image name + LS address; the 1.00 twins (byte-identical modules, re/data/spu_map_114.tsv) have their own rows.
